channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: How Trump Is Dismantling America’s Scientific Research Machine
item.description: The system that has driven life-altering discoveries and helped make the United States a superpower is now under intense strain.

item.title: NPR: Justice Department seeks to isolate Alaska ballots amid criminal probe over Senate candidate
item.description: The latest developments come amid allegations, first reported by The New York Times, that Democrats recruited a spoiler candidate in the toss-up U.S. Senate race.

item.title: BBC News: Burnham 'open' to calls for slavery apology but not reparations
item.description: The British government has never formally apologised for slavery despite repeated calls from a number of Commonwealth leaders.

item.title: The Guardian: Día de los Muertos celebrations rise from the dead as ICE arrests continue: ‘It’s important to bring joy in dark times’
item.description: After canceling events in 2025, US cities including Henderson, Kentucky, are reviving public Day of the Dead events Julia, a 19-year-old born in the US, and her parents, undocumented immigrants from Mexico, enjoyed atten…

item.title: Al Jazeera: Iran FM says US outreach a ‘positive step’ as delegation in Qatar for talks
item.description: Iran’s Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi tells Al Jazeera Tehran doesn't rule out attack, is ‘prepared for all scenarios’.

item.title: Ars Technica: Seabirds racing home over the ocean can get jet-lagged
item.description: A long flight home from feeding grounds messes with birds' internal clocks.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: I Gave My Blood to the AI Death Clock
item.description: Death Clock promises to predict when you’re going to die and help you extend your time on Earth. After a month, I felt like it was sucking the life out of me.

item.title: WIRED Science: An AI Agent Injected Drugs Into a Live Mouse’s Brain
item.description: A biotech startup let an agent choose a gene therapy and successfully inject the treatment, offering a startling glimpse of the future of research labs.

item.title: WIRED Business: Meta’s Muse Could Upend All Kinds of Businesses. It Hasn’t Yet
item.description: Companies have spent the past several weeks trying to reassure investors that Muse and other AI agents pose more of an opportunity than a threat.

item.title: The New Yorker: Inside India’s Cockroach Protests
item.description: The youth movement that has roiled the country prepares its next move.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: The ‘Sex Diaries’ That Brought Roommates Into the Mix
item.description: A look back at the anonymous diarists who mixed pleasure with cohabitation, for better and for worse.

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: Where Gothic Revival Meets Grown-up Eloise
item.description: Nina Johnson’s Tudor City home by Adam Charlap Hyman is a cloud of gray with a touch of Lynchian red.
